name: Sumo platform
_effects_note: Resistance V: no damage is taken, only knockback. Sumo is decided by falling, never by health.
_attributes_note: Vanilla knockback. Halving it (0.5) made a constantly circling bot impossible to push off: every match drew at the cap. At 0.0 the house bot beats a circler in 24 to 56 s and a random bot in 3 to 6 s.
